properties.displayName: QC - Billable data ingestion threshold surpassed
properties.description:
This query identifies the volume of billable data ingested into the workspace in the most recent full day and
establishes if this is greater than the expected volume for this workspace. It uses two measures to establish if
the volume of data is greater than expected. Firstly, a threshold of expected daily volume (in GB) can be provided
in the watchlist "UsageThreshold". Secondly, the query calculates the average volume of data seen per day in the 13
days preceding the query frequency and calculates a threshold based on an increase of 30% of this value. If the
volume of billable data within the query frequency exceeds the higher of these thresholds, an alert will be triggered.
The projected columns provide the volume of billable data ingested within the query frequency (GBytes) and the values
of the two thresholds used.
